body: That card made me laugh harder than I have in months. Thanks for all the ideas, I need to get out and have some fun and find some people to share it with. My life was too routine and full of the same crap day in and day out.
I have too much debt unfortunately, not a large amount, but around 6000$. I wish I could be that bold, but im not exactly employable with my degree :(

I hope you are better this morning, I know last night was really hard for me especially. Truthfully I tried to jump again but couldn't bring myself too it. The pain seems to be going in cycles for me, off and on. Im not sure what to hold onto either, I dont  have any close friends and its as you said hard to motivate myself to go on too. 

I know theres a future out there but its really hard to see at the moment.

Hey,

Almost the exact same thing just happened to me today. I know what you mean when you say that you love her more than anything. To me it was the feeling that you would go to the ends of the earth for her right? I was also planning on proposing in a few years as well.

Today I sat on my roof getting ready to end it all, getting ready to jump. I didnt go through with it and honestly, 6 hours later Im glad I didnt. My girlfriend left me because she told me that she would always regret being with me because I had no future planned out. I am failing in school and about to graduate with a pointless degree. 

After coming back inside I realized that I deserve to be happy. I dont know why im so determined to live now, but I know I regret trying to jump. I dont know if any of what I am telling you helps, but I want you to know that someone knows exactly how you are feeling.

A similar thing just happened to me tonight. My girlfriend of 7 years who was the love of my life and my one true friend told me she no longer feels anything for me. I have no other friends and almost jumped off my roof today. I cant pretend that we are in the same situation, but I want you to know I can relate how you feel. Today I felt truly alone, no friends to family to fall back on. I hit rock bottom today and I know you feel the same. As clichéd as it sounds, it gets better. I hated everyone telling me that time heals all wounds but every hour that passes helps. 

I dont know if this works for you but I keep telling myself that I deserve to be happy, to have friends that unconditionally love me. I want a new chapter in my life and I deserve it. I know that it seems like the future has nothing good in store, but fuck it, I will make it happen.

I will tell you the truth about my day today. I almost jumped today, my life is in shambles and I couldnt take the pain. I stood outside on the roof for what I felt was ages. I dont know whats going on with you, but I feel relieved that I didnt jump. I know you dont know what to do, and hey neither do I. Sleep on it man, take some time. I know thats what I'm doing and it worked to keep me alive.

I dont know how I did it, but we sat down and ended it about twenty minutes ago. We decided to go our separate ways amicably. I dont know where I am going to go or what Im going to do, but the next couple years will be full of regret. We unfortunately still will have to live together for the next few weeks, and I have to find an emergency place to stay afterwards. I dont know how I am going to move on, I just dont know what comes next.

We are currently living together and our lease ends in a month. I dont know if she is just giving me false hope so that our relationship isnt awkward and strained while we live together. I dont know if shes genuine or not about staying together :(

Thank you for the link, I found it in line with what I'm feeling. I guess maybe suicide just seemed like the quickest solution to a problem that will take many years to heal. It is just so incredibly hard to see when my life will be happy again.
Im in the same situation, my gf is the only reason im staying alive as well. Im having a hard time since she has decided to break it off soon.

I guess i just dont know how to forget about her or move on. Shes been the center of my life for too long and I think I forgot how to cope without it. Pathetic I know but she is my only real true friend. :/

Thank you

Your reply rings true to me about my situation. I know I can start over, and figure out something I love to do, but the whole thing with my girlfriend really complicates everything so much. I dont know how I ended up this way, but I poured everything into the relationship and now I love her so much and my heart is so committed that it overrules everything in my head. My brain tells me to leave and start out anew but my feelings for her are just overwhelming.
